name: cheap-route
description: Sends read-only subagent and workflow-agent tasks to a cheaper model and switches a task up to the session model when it needs to write, gets stuck or is unsure.

enabled.title: Route easy tasks
enabled.description: Turn the routing on or off.

cheapModel.title: Cheap model
cheapModel.description: The model easy subagent tasks run on.

maxEasyChars.title: Longest easy prompt
maxEasyChars.description: A task prompt longer than this many characters is never treated as easy.

maxCheapSteps.title: Most cheap steps
maxCheapSteps.description: A cheap subagent that needs more model requests than this switches to the session model.
